note: Wording source for the in-chat clickable picker. Live asks reuse this schema; extra options (lock ranks, R-… ids) are filled at ask time. A click in chat is the reply. The HTML demo does not authorize.

decisions.title: What kind of claim is this?
decisions.prompt_plain: Say what this sentence is doing before anyone scores it.

options.label: Descriptive
options.plain_language: This is a claim about how the world is — facts, causes, or structure.
options.does_not_mean: That the facts have been proved. You are only labeling the job.

options.label: Normative / Strategic
options.plain_language: This is a claim about values, “should,” advocacy, or what to do.
options.does_not_mean: That the recommendation is established. A should-claim still has to be constrained.

options.label: Mixed — split the parts
options.plain_language: This sentence mixes facts and “should.” Split them so they are not scored as one blob.
options.does_not_mean: That you can score the mix as a single yes/no.

decisions.title: How strong do you mean?
decisions.prompt_plain: Words like “could,” “likely,” or “should” need a height before you hunt for evidence. Choosing the height is not meeting it.

options.label: P-Logical (merely possible)
options.plain_language: You only mean it is not a contradiction — a very low bar, often near-empty if unbounded.
options.does_not_mean: That the claim is realistic or expected.

options.label: P-NonNegligible
options.plain_language: You mean there is a real, not-tiny chance — still not “this is the base case.”
options.does_not_mean: That a price, print, or slogan has cleared the bar.

options.label: P-BaseCase
options.plain_language: You mean this is the expected or central path, not merely possible.
options.does_not_mean: That a nearby “potential” reading is enough.

options.label: Other bar (name it)
options.plain_language: You want a different named height. Say it in ordinary words before testing.
options.does_not_mean: That you can leave the strength vague and still score.

decisions.title: Keep the original wording?
decisions.prompt_plain: Decide whether the sentence on the record stays as written, or you authorize a revision path.

options.label: Keep original wording
options.plain_language: Leave the claim as stated. Later work tests this wording, not a quieter rewrite.
options.does_not_mean: That the slogan is true.

options.label: Revise claim
options.plain_language: Authorize Claim-Revision Scaffolding before anyone invents a successor sentence.
options.does_not_mean: That the agent may silently swap in a new claim.

decisions.title: Bring in earlier frozen meanings?
decisions.prompt_plain: If this toolkit already froze a meaning that applies here, import it and check it against these facts — before the first full scoring pass.

options.label: Import named locks
options.plain_language: Use the named earlier freeze(s) as starting constraints, then check they do not clash with this claim’s facts.
options.does_not_mean: That those locks apply automatically or that the claim is proved.

options.label: None — do not import
options.plain_language: No earlier freeze fits this run honestly. Record “none imported.”
options.does_not_mean: That locks are banned forever; only that none apply now.

decisions.title: Gate verdict for this layer
decisions.prompt_plain: This is a gate verdict for the layer as constrained — not a press-release “yes” to the original slogan.

options.label: Admissible
options.plain_language: This layer can be carried forward as stated, given the gates and what has been admitted.
options.does_not_mean: That the original slogan is fully established in everyday speech.

options.label: Provisional
options.plain_language: Well-posed enough to continue or close with limits — not a full unrestricted yes.
options.does_not_mean: A polite word for “true.”

options.label: Not admissible
options.plain_language: Do not carry this layer forward as stated.
options.does_not_mean: That every nearby question is closed, or that a quieter rewrite is automatically true.

decisions.title: What next after this scoring pass?
decisions.prompt_plain: Decide whether to stop here or name leftover choices that still block a fair test.

options.label: Stop / remain provisional
options.plain_language: Do not open more search. Record the verdict and park leftovers if needed.
options.does_not_mean: That the slogan is cleared.

options.label: Extract gaps
options.plain_language: Name and rank the leftover choices, then (on the Lean Default Path) attack only the top one or two.
options.does_not_mean: That you should open every nearby side question.

decisions.title: Allow this source in?
decisions.prompt_plain: Does this candidate actually speak to the leftover you named, and does it clash with the starting facts?

options.label: Admit
options.plain_language: Allow this source in: it constrains the targeted leftover and stays consistent with the facts already on the table.
options.does_not_mean: That the original slogan is now true.

options.label: Reject
options.plain_language: Do not allow it in. It fails relevance, consistency, or both.
options.does_not_mean: That Ambiguity magically fell anyway.

options.label: Hold
options.plain_language: Park it. It needs more context or splitting before a yes or no.
options.does_not_mean: A hidden admit.

decisions.title: Live shot or stand-in?
decisions.prompt_plain: Say whether the number or print in front of you is the live object the claim named, or a proxy / stand-in.

options.label: Live
options.plain_language: This is the actual live print or object the freeze named.
options.does_not_mean: That matching a print clears a locked bar by itself.

options.label: Stand-in / proxy
options.plain_language: This is a substitute or same-day stand-in, not the live object itself. Badge it that way.
options.does_not_mean: That a proxy may silently pose as the live shot.

options.label: Out of package
options.plain_language: This material is outside the locked package. Do not treat it as in-package evidence.
options.does_not_mean: That it can be smuggled in because it is interesting.

decisions.title: Which lock package?
decisions.prompt_plain: Pick one explicit freeze package. Live asks replace these slots with the actual Rank / package IDs on the table. Locks are never automatic.

options.label: Rank 1 / first package
options.plain_language: Use the first named package (live ask will show its real ID and what it freezes).
options.does_not_mean: That freezing a meaning proves the claim.

options.label: Rank 2 / second package
options.plain_language: Use the second named package.
options.does_not_mean: That a lower Rank is a weaker truth-claim; it is a different freeze.

options.label: Rank 3 / third package
options.plain_language: Use the third named package.
options.does_not_mean: Automatic application to later claims.

options.label: Do not lock yet
options.plain_language: Leave meanings unfrozen for now. Scoring stays on the current reading.
options.does_not_mean: That the agent may pick a package for you.

decisions.title: Authorize Phase 2?
decisions.prompt_plain: Phase 2 does not start unless you say so. It is a deeper evidence pass, not a second slogan.

options.label: Authorize Phase 2
options.plain_language: Allow one Phase 2 attempt on the frozen leftover, under the current anchors and locks.
options.does_not_mean: That the bar is already met, or that Phase 2 runs forever.

options.label: Do not enter Phase 2
options.plain_language: Stay at Phase 1 / closeout. No deeper pass this turn.
options.does_not_mean: That leftovers vanish.

decisions.title: Authorize Experimental Generation?
decisions.prompt_plain: This mode is not a substitute for Phase 1 or Phase 2. It needs its own yes.

options.label: Authorize Experimental Generation
options.plain_language: Allow one experimental batch to try generating constraints that ordinary search could not.
options.does_not_mean: That generated text is admitted evidence, or that it proves the claim.

options.label: Do not run it
options.plain_language: Skip this mode. Ordinary gated steps remain the path.
options.does_not_mean: That the leftover is solved.

decisions.title: Stop examination, or seal the file?
decisions.prompt_plain: Endpoint means examination of this wording is done. Hard stop means the write-up hygiene is done too.

options.label: Endpoint only
options.plain_language: Freeze the verdict for the claim as stated, but do not finish the closeout paperwork yet.
options.does_not_mean: That leftovers are abandoned, or that the slogan is proved.

options.label: Closeout / hard stop
options.plain_language: Finish the write-up and seal the record for this wording.
options.does_not_mean: That pursue leftovers must be parked or dropped.

decisions.title: What to do with leftover questions?
decisions.prompt_plain: Offering a leftover menu is not running a leftover. Pick how to treat the menu.

options.label: Authorize a residual branch
options.plain_language: Open work on a named leftover (live ask will show which R-…).
options.does_not_mean: Automatic Phase 2, or that the parent verdict changed.

options.label: Decline residual menu
options.plain_language: Do not open a leftover branch from this menu right now.
options.does_not_mean: That the leftovers were solved.

options.label: Name a source class
options.plain_language: Name the public source class for an empirical leftover so it can be tested fairly.
options.does_not_mean: That naming a class meets a locked bar.

decisions.title: How should this leftover sit?
decisions.prompt_plain: Park only when that is honest. Named, obtainable leftovers are not “wait for a better system.”

options.label: Pursue
options.plain_language: This leftover can be worked now (data or a named class is obtainable).
options.does_not_mean: That the parent claim is reopened, or that Phase 2 auto-starts.

options.label: Park until trigger
options.plain_language: Wait for a named future event (for example a missing print). Say the trigger.
options.does_not_mean: A hidden “therefore yes.”

options.label: Park 90 days
options.plain_language: Same identification block or diminishing returns — review again on the quarterly cadence.
options.does_not_mean: Drop, or a proof that the leftover is unimportant.

options.label: Drop
options.plain_language: Do not keep this leftover on the queue. Say why.
options.does_not_mean: That the parent slogan is established.

decisions.title: Quarterly parked-leftover review
decisions.prompt_plain: For each park-90d row: promote, extend, convert, or drop. Do not churn park-until-trigger unless its trigger has fired.

options.label: Promote to pursue
options.plain_language: This parked item can be worked now. Move it to pursue.
options.does_not_mean: Silent Phase 2 or a verdict change.

options.label: Extend park
options.plain_language: Keep it parked ~90 more days. Cadence-existence is not quarterly proof.
options.does_not_mean: That the leftover was examined in depth this session.

options.label: Convert to park-until-trigger
options.plain_language: Replace the 90-day park with a named future trigger.
options.does_not_mean: That the trigger already fired.

options.label: Drop
options.plain_language: Remove it from the 90-day queue. Record why.
options.does_not_mean: Parent clearance.

decisions.title: Optional tools after results exist
decisions.prompt_plain: These tools are offered, not auto-run. Running one still needs a letter. Declining is a real choice.

options.label: Run Use-Exploration (UX)
options.plain_language: Explore possible uses of the findings, guided by the claim’s intent — not advice and not a verdict change.
options.does_not_mean: That uses are established truth.

options.label: Run Contrastive Recommendation (CX)
options.plain_language: Ask what different claims would fit the evidence better. That is not a silent rewrite of this claim.
options.does_not_mean: That the parent verdict is replaced.

options.label: Run Claim-Revision (CR)
options.plain_language: Open the revision scaffolding instead of inventing a new sentence in place.
options.does_not_mean: A quiet swap of the original wording.

options.label: Run Quantitative Implication (QI)
options.plain_language: Work a numerical implication or counterfactual. Implications are not proof of the claim.
options.does_not_mean: That a number in a table meets a locked bar.

options.label: Decline all optional modes
options.plain_language: Do not run UX, CX, CR, or QI. The offer still happened; the runs did not.
options.does_not_mean: That the tools were unavailable.

decisions.title: Which Quantitative Implication path?
decisions.prompt_plain: If QI is in play, choose how far it goes. None of these paths prove the original slogan.

options.label: Full path (A + B)
options.plain_language: Run the scale-factor sketch and then gate the conditioned benefit claim.
options.does_not_mean: Proof of the parent claim.

options.label: Scale-factor only (A)
options.plain_language: Run only the numerical scale sketch, not the gated benefit claim.
options.does_not_mean: That the benefit is established.

options.label: Neither
options.plain_language: Do not run QI paths.
options.does_not_mean: That numbers already on the table are a QI result.

decisions.title: Allow a stipulated proxy?
decisions.prompt_plain: A stand-in used on purpose still has to be named as a stand-in.

options.label: Stipulate this proxy
options.plain_language: Yes: use this named stand-in, and badge it as a stand-in — not as the live object.
options.does_not_mean: Print-match clearance, or that the proxy is the thing itself.

options.label: Do not stipulate
options.plain_language: Do not treat this as an allowed stand-in.
options.does_not_mean: That a live shot has been found.

decisions.title: Start a successor application?
decisions.prompt_plain: A new folder is a new claim. It does not inherit this verdict.

options.label: Start successor app
options.plain_language: Open a new application for a different wording or leftover. No conclusion inheritance.
options.does_not_mean: That this file’s verdict transfers.

options.label: Do not start a successor
options.plain_language: Stay on this application. Do not open a new claim folder.
options.does_not_mean: That leftovers cannot be parked here.

decisions.title: How should Phase 1 continue?
decisions.prompt_plain: While leftover unclarity is still mainly descriptive, the method may continue cycles. You can slow that to one admit at a time.

options.label: Proceed as recommended
options.plain_language: Continue the auto-continue class as the method recommends (still stopping on meaning-forks and establishment calls).
options.does_not_mean: That bars may be marked met without a stop.

options.label: One admit at a time
options.plain_language: Pause between admission cycles so you can see each source before the next.
options.does_not_mean: A weaker method, or skipped consistency checks.

decisions.title: Name the source class, or leave it unnamed?
decisions.prompt_plain: An empirical leftover needs a specific public class before it can be tested. “Some independent forecast” is not named enough.

options.label: Name a source class
options.plain_language: You will name a specific public series or class (live ask will record the words).
options.does_not_mean: That the class has already met a locked bar.

options.label: Leave unnamed
options.plain_language: Do not invent a class. The leftover stays blocked until a real name is given.
options.does_not_mean: That the agent may invent Kalshi, CME, or similar for you.
